1. (Currently amended) A method of treating Argininosuccinate Synthetase Deficiency (ASD), [[comprising]] __the method comprising__ administering to a __human__ subject in need of treatment __by intravenous administration__ a composition comprising an mRNA encoding argininosuccinate synthetase (ASS1) __encapsulated within a liposome comprising one or more cationic lipids, one or more non-cationic lipids, one or more cholesterol-based lipids and one or more PEG-modified lipids, wherein the ratio of the one or more cationic lipids:the one or more non-cationic lipids:the one or more cholesterol-based lipids:the one or more PEG-modified lipids is approximately 40:30:20:10 by molar ratio,__ at an effective dose and an administration interval such that at least one symptom or feature of [[ASD]] __the ASD__ is reduced in intensity, severity, or frequency or [[has delayed in onset]] __is delayed in onset__.

2. (Previously presented) The method of claim 1, wherein the mRNA is encapsulated within a liposome.

3. (Previously presented) The method of claim 2, wherein the liposome comprises one or more cationic lipids, one or more non-cationic lipids, one or more cholesterol-based lipids and one or more PEG-modified lipids.

4. (Previously presented) The method of claim 3, wherein the one or more cationic lipids comprise a cationic lipid selected from the group consisting of C12-200, MC3, DLinDMA, DLinkC2DMA, cKK-E12, ICE (Imidazol-based), HGT5000, HGT5001, DODAC, DDAB, DMRIE, DOSPA, DOGS, DODAP, DODMA and DMDMA, DODAC, DLenDMA, DMRIE, CLinDMA, CpLinDMA, DMOBA, DOcarbDAP, DLinDAP, DLincarbDAP, DLinCDAP, KLin-K-DMA, DLin-K-XTC2-DMA, HGT4003, and combination thereof.

5. (Previously presented) The method of claim 4, wherein the one or more cationic lipids comprise cKK-E12.

6. (Previously presented) The method of claim 3, wherein the one or more cholesterol-based lipids are cholesterol and/or PEGylated cholesterol.

7. (Currently amended) The method of claim 3, wherein the __one or more__ cationic lipid[[s]] constitute[[s]] about 30-50% of the liposome by weight.

8. (Currently amended) The method of claim 3, wherein the ratio of __the one or more__ cationic lipid[[s]]:__the one or more__ non-cationic lipid[[s]]:__the one or more cholesterol-based__ cholesterol[[-based lipids]]:__the one or more PEG-modified__ PEGylated lipid[[s]] is approximately 40:30:20:10 by molar ratio.

9. (Previously presented) The method of claim 2, wherein the liposome comprises a combination selected from: cKK-E12, DOPE, cholesterol and DMG-PEG2K; C12-200, DOPE, cholesterol and DMG-PEG2K; HGT4003, DOPE, cholesterol and DMG-PEG2K; or ICE, DOPE, cholesterol and DMG-PEG2K.

10. (Previously presented) The method of claim 2, wherein the liposome has a size less than about 100 nm.

11. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein [[the mRNA is administered at]] the effective dose [[ranging]] __ranges__ from about 0.1-5.0 mg/kg body weight.

12. (Previously presented) The method of claim 1, wherein the composition is administered intravenously.

13. (Previously presented) The method of claim 1, wherein the composition is administered once a week.

14. (Cancelled)

15. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the administering of the composition results in reduced citrulline level in the subject as compared to the baseline citrulline level before the treatment.

16. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the administering of the composition results in reduced ammonia level in the subject as compared to the baseline ammonia level before the treatment.

17. (Previously presented) The method of claim 1, wherein the mRNA is codon optimized.

18. (Original) The method of claim 17, wherein the codon-optimized mRNA comprises SEQ ID NO:3.

19. (Previously presented) The method of claim 1, wherein the mRNA comprises one or more modified nucleotides.

20. (Original) The method of claim 1, wherein the mRNA is unmodified.
